items.q: In the person of Buddy Collette, C-o-l-l-e-t-t-e, or how many "l"s?

ctx.x: But she could only see that jazz music was noise, because she went around to several places, and she classified it all as the same. And in one of those particular places that she went to was one of the most famous and the most equipped musical jazz groups in the world. In the person of Buddy Collette, C-o-l-l-e-t-t-e, or how many "l"s?
Yes, right, that's how it's spelled.
